root.docs: Generated together with the Postman collection. Pick the 'local' environment; when Keycloak auth is on, fill keycloak_client_secret, keycloak_username and keycloak_password and run 00 Auth / A01 first. Image tests read files from test_images/ in the project folder: set the collection's location to the project folder.
